items.title: Red Holloway interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995
items.q: I went on the road with Jimmy Reed in 1957, all down in Florida

ctx.x: And he can say anything and it goes because of his voice, and the way he pronounce. Another person that was like that — Jimmy Reed. Now Jimmy Reed was another, he was just a master of that. But all of his stuff kind of was lyrical and it had, it always came out. I remember, I’m trying to think where his wife was in the studio with him. And you could hear her saying the words and he would, I can remember —
